Solana capture writer functions for account, bank, transaction, and reward protobuf chunks.

# Purpose
`fd_solcap_writer.c` implements the file writer for Solana capture data. It defines the `fd_solcap_writer_t` state object and the functions that create, initialize, update, flush, and delete that writer. The code writes a stream of chunked binary records to a `FILE` object, with support for file headers, chunk headers, alignment, and offset fixups. It uses nanopb to encode protobuf metadata and uses file seeks to backfill chunk headers after the payload is written.

The main purpose of the file is to record bank capture data for a slot-based workflow. It supports writing account records, buffering an account table, writing bank preimage data, writing transactions, and writing stake reward records. The functions [`fd_solcap_write_account`](<#fd_solcap_write_account>), [`fd_solcap_write_bank_preimage`](<#fd_solcap_write_bank_preimage>), [`fd_solcap_write_transaction2`](<#fd_solcap_write_transaction2>), and the stake reward helpers build the protobuf messages and write them with the correct chunk magic values and offsets. The file also includes error handling for file I/O failures and enforces hosted-platform use with `FD_HAS_HOSTED`.
